Height above the top of the building: $h''=-32$, $h'(t)=v_0-32t$. Passing the window at $t=4$ while falling at 96 ft/s: $v_0-128=-96\Rightarrow v_0=32$. So $h(t)=32t-16t^2$.

It hits the ground at $t=5$: $h(5)=160-400=-240$, so the building is 240 ft tall. The window is at $h(4)=128-256=-128$, i.e. 128 ft below the top:
\[\text{window height}=240-128=\boxed{112\ \text{ft}}.\]
6:
Let $z$ be height measured from the tank's center ($-2\le z\le2$). The center is $1+2=3$ m below ground, so a slice at $z$ is lifted $3-z$ m. Its area is $\pi(4-z^2)$:
\[W=\int_{-2}^29800\pi(4-z^2)(3-z)\,dz=9800\pi\Big[3\int_{-2}^2(4-z^2)dz-\underbrace{\int_{-2}^2z(4-z^2)dz}_{0\ (\text{odd})}\Big]=9800\pi\cdot3\cdot\frac{32}{3}.\]
\[W=313600\pi\approx\boxed{9.85\times10^5\ \text{J}}.\]
7:
On $[0,\frac{2\pi}{3}]$: $\cos x-\cos2x=-(2\cos x+1)(\cos x-1)\ge0$, so $\cos x$ is on top.

\textbf{(a)} $A=\Big[\sin x-\frac{\sin2x}{2}\Big]_0^{2\pi/3}=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}+\frac{\sqrt3}{4}=\boxed{\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}}$.

\textbf{(b)} $M_y=\int_0^{2\pi/3}x(\cos x-\cos2x)dx=\Big[x\sin x+\cos x-\frac{x\sin2x}{2}-\frac{\cos2x}{4}\Big]_0^{2\pi/3}=\frac{\pi\sqrt3}{2}-\frac98$.

$M_x=\int_0^{2\pi/3}\frac12(\cos^2x-\cos^22x)dx=\frac14\int_0^{2\pi/3}(\cos2x-\cos4x)dx=\frac14\Big[\frac{\sin2x}{2}-\frac{\sin4x}{4}\Big]_0^{2\pi/3}=-\frac{3\sqrt3}{32}$.
\[(\bar x,\bar y)=\Big(\frac{M_y}{A},\frac{M_x}{A}\Big)=\boxed{\Big(\frac{2\pi}{3}-\frac{\sqrt3}{2},\ -\frac18\Big)}\approx(1.228,\,-0.125).\]

\textbf{(a)} \boxed{\dfrac{dA}{dt}=k\sqrt{A}\,(100-A)}.

\textbf{(b)} Let $u=\sqrt A$ ($A=u^2$, $A'=2uu'$): $2uu'=ku(100-u^2)$, so $u'=\frac k2(100-u^2)$. Separate with $\frac{1}{100-u^2}=\frac1{20}\Big(\frac1{10-u}+\frac1{10+u}\Big)$:
\[\frac1{20}\ln\frac{10+u}{10-u}=\frac k2t+C\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{10+u}{10-u}=Be^{10kt}.\]
$A(0)=4$ ($u=2$): $B=\frac{12}{8}=\frac32$. $A(9)=25$ ($u=5$): $3=\frac32e^{90k}\Rightarrow e^{10k}=2^{1/9}$. So with $R(t)=\frac32\cdot2^{t/9}$, $u=10\frac{R-1}{R+1}$:
\[\boxed{A(t)=100\Big(\frac{\frac32\,2^{t/9}-1}{\frac32\,2^{t/9}+1}\Big)^2=100\Big(\frac{3\cdot2^{t/9}-2}{3\cdot2^{t/9}+2}\Big)^2}\quad(\text{check: }A(0)=4,\ A(9)=25).\]
